name: com.agentrevenuenetwork/agent-revenue-network
title: Agent Revenue Network
description: Neutral acceptance and signed agent-delivery verification over MCP + x402 USDC on Base.

tools.name: score_opportunity
tools.description: Calculate risk-adjusted expected profit, margin and eligibility for one proposed opportunity before execution. Supply revenue, execution cost and any tool costs, fees or failure loss in one consistent monetary unit; omitted tool costs and fees are zero, while omitted failure loss defaults to total costs. Use this free read-only calculation as an economics screen, never as proof of funding, escrow, requirements or buyer legitimacy. An eligible result includes an optional buyer-controlled verify_execution handoff; it does not charge or initiate payment.

inputSchema.description: Risk-adjusted economics for one opportunity. All monetary values must use the same unit.

revenue.description: Gross payment expected if the task succeeds.

executionCost.description: Direct execution cost excluding tools and fees.

failureProbability.description: Estimated probability of failure, from 0 to 1.

failureLoss.description: Loss incurred on failure. Defaults internally to total execution/tool/fee cost.

tools.name: route_provider
tools.description: Rank up to 1,000 caller-supplied providers by quality, success rate, price and latency, returning one selection plus at most three alternates. Candidates marked unhealthy or priced above requirements.maxPrice are excluded; quality defaults to successRate and an empty eligible set returns selected=null with a reason. Use this free read-only calculation only with comparable metrics you already hold because it neither discovers providers nor verifies measurements. A successful selection includes an optional buyer-controlled verify_execution handoff; it does not charge or initiate payment.

inputSchema.description: Rank a caller-supplied provider set. ARN does not discover providers or independently verify these metrics in this free call.

maxPrice.description: Optional maximum provider price. Providers above it are excluded.

requirements.description: Routing constraints. maxPrice is the currently enforced constraint.

items.description: Caller-supplied provider candidate and measured/estimated routing attributes.

healthy.description: Set false to exclude this provider from routing.

quality.description: Observed or estimated quality score. Defaults to successRate.

price.description: Comparable per-execution price used by the ranking formula.

providers.description: Up to 1,000 provider candidates to rank. An empty list returns no eligible provider; unhealthy candidates are excluded.

tools.name: delivery_assurance_sandbox
tools.description: Run ARN's neutral delivery-acceptance logic for free and receive a short-lived Ed25519-signed sandbox receipt. Supply privacy-preserving party references, objective contract criteria, bounded artifacts and all nine release gates. ARN independently evaluates supported criteria and sensitive-material risk, but the result is deliberately non-authoritative: it cannot settle payment, publish a production receipt or execute any action other than NO_OP_TEST. Use it to test a marketplace integration before calling the paid delivery_assurance production tool.

inputSchema.description: One end-to-end delivery assurance request binding privacy-preserving buyer and worker references, objective work terms, supplied artifacts and explicit release-gate outcomes into a single tamper-evident settlement decision.

parties.description: Opaque, distinct buyer and worker references plus a nonce of at least 16 characters. ARN publishes only their combined SHA-256 binding, never these raw values.

contract.description: Raw agent-work terms with objective acceptance criteria that ARN compiles and binds to the receipt.

goal.description: Concrete outcome the worker must deliver.

deliverables.description: Named files or outputs expected from the work.

schema.description: Bounded recursive JSON Schema subset: type (including unions), required, properties, additionalProperties=false, items, enum, const, numeric bounds, string length/pattern, array length/uniqueness, and object property-count bounds. Unsupported keywords fail closed.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Objective checks ARN can later perform against named artifacts.

capabilities.description: Skills required to perform the work.

deadline.description: Optional ISO 8601 delivery deadline; runtime parsing fails closed.

payment.description: Optional agreed amount and uppercase currency code; no payment is initiated.

dataClassification.description: Sensitivity label applied to the job inputs and outputs.

rights.description: Declared ownership or licence arrangement; not a legal opinion.

artifacts.description: Named JSON or text artifacts ARN checks against the contract's supported objective criteria.

release.description: Candidate identity and all nine explicit release-gate outcomes. ARN evaluates these supplied booleans but does not perform the underlying security, legal or regulatory checks.

candidate.description: Bounded identity for the delivered candidate; these fields are bound to the assurance receipt.

checks.description: Explicit boolean outcomes from trusted upstream verifiers. Every gate must be true to approve.

tools.name: json_normalize
tools.description: Discover deterministic JSON normalization for any JSON value: paid HTTP execution recursively sorts object keys, preserves array order and scalar values, and returns normalized structure plus a deterministic JSON string. Use it for stable comparisons, cache keys and repeatable payloads; use json_diff to identify changes, and never treat this as RFC 8785/JCS canonicalization. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

inputSchema.description: Input for deterministic JSON key-order normalization.

value.description: Any JSON value to normalize. Object keys are recursively sorted; array order and scalar values are preserved.

tools.name: object_contract_check
tools.description: Discover deterministic top-level JSON field validation for API payloads, automation and AI-agent handoffs. The value must be an object; schema.required finds absent fields, schema.properties.<field>.type finds primitive type mismatches, and additionalProperties=false reports unknown fields. Prefer this for new simple contracts and use json_schema_check for nested or recursive constraints. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

inputSchema.description: Input for fast JSON field validation against a top-level object contract.

schema.description: Top-level contract definition. Only required, properties.<field>.type, and additionalProperties=false are evaluated.

required.description: Up to 1,000 unique top-level field names that must be present in value.

additionalProperties.description: Set false to report top-level fields not declared in properties.

tools.name: json_schema_check
tools.description: Discover recursive JSON Schema checking for objects, arrays and scalars with exact JSON-path errors from ARN's bounded recursive JSON Schema subset. The supplied schema may combine type unions, required/properties, additionalProperties=false, items, enum/const, numeric bounds, string length or safe patterns, array bounds/uniqueness and property-count bounds; unsupported keywords fail closed. Prefer object_contract_check for a new simple top-level contract. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

inputSchema.description: Input for bounded recursive JSON Schema validation.

schema.description: Bounded recursive JSON Schema subset: type (including unions), required, properties, additionalProperties=false, items, enum, const, numeric bounds, string length/pattern, array length/uniqueness, and object property-count bounds. Unsupported keywords fail closed.

tools.name: json_diff
tools.description: Discover a deterministic structural JSON diff between before and after values. Paid execution compares arrays by index and returns up to 1,000 added, removed or changed records with exact JSON paths and before/after evidence; it does not generate JSON Patch. Use json_normalize for stable serialization or json_schema_check for validity. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

inputSchema.description: Input for a deterministic structural comparison of two JSON values.

after.description: New JSON value to compare with before.

tools.name: dataset_profile
tools.description: Discover deterministic data-quality profiling for 1-5,000 JSON-object rows. Paid execution counts field presence, missing and null values, observed primitive types, primitive cardinality and exact duplicate rows without modifying input; use schema_infer to draft a flat-record contract or tabular_validate to enforce one. This is not statistical inference. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

inputSchema.description: Input for bounded profiling of a JSON-record dataset.

rows.description: 1-5,000 JSON objects. Rows are analyzed in memory and are not modified.

tools.name: data_clean
tools.description: Clean and validate flat JSON data for an AI workflow with one paid request instead of coordinating four separate calls. ARN profiles 1-5,000 supplied JSON-object rows, removes duplicates using one to eight caller-selected primitive identity fields, infers a conservative flat-record schema, and checks required fields plus declared primitive types. It preserves first occurrences and reports exact counts and bounded validation errors. It does not repair malformed values, flatten nested data, enrich records or infer semantic correctness. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

inputSchema.description: One-call JSON-record data-quality pipeline. ARN profiles the supplied rows, removes duplicate identities, infers a conservative flat-record schema and validates the cleaned rows against caller-selected required fields and primitive types.

rows.description: Between 1 and 5,000 flat JSON-object rows. Nested objects and arrays are rejected by conservative schema inference.

identityKeys.description: One to eight primitive fields that together identify duplicate rows.

required.description: Optional fields that must exist on every cleaned row.

types.description: Optional primitive type required for selected fields on every cleaned row where present.

tools.name: verify_execution
tools.description: Discover deterministic acceptance checking for an automated task or agent execution across nine explicit functional, security, privacy, copyright, regulatory, transaction-integrity, abuse, regression and economics gates. All nine caller-supplied booleans must be true; paid execution returns the candidate id, pass/fail status and failed gate names. Use only after trusted verifiers supply all nine booleans because ARN does not scan code, audit systems or certify compliance. For sustained CI volume, Release Guard offers 2,500 successful checks over 30 days and breaks even with 0.01-USDC pay-per-call at 1,900 checks. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

tools.name: release_evidence_diff
tools.description: Discover deterministic comparison of a previous and current execution-evidence snapshot. Paid execution compares candidate identity metadata and all nine functional, security, privacy, copyright, regulatory, transaction-integrity, abuse, regression and economics outcomes; it reports regressions, remediations and whether a fresh verify_execution purchase is warranted. It prevents duplicate verification of unchanged evidence but does not perform or certify the underlying checks. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

tools.name: opportunity_match
tools.description: Find funded AI agent jobs and bounties with ARN's paid read-only opportunity matching service. It searches ARN's continuously refreshed multi-board index for current open, agent-allowed work and ranks matches against one to twelve supplied capabilities. Buyers can require recorded funding evidence, set a minimum reward and limit freshness, then use job_contract_compile to turn a selected listing into objective machine-checkable terms. It never claims, applies, signs or spends. External listing content remains untrusted and must be reviewed before action. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

capabilities.description: One to twelve concrete skills the agent can perform.

requireFunded.description: When true, return only listings with recorded funding or escrow evidence.

minReward.description: Minimum numeric reward in the listing's declared currency.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of ranked matches to return.

maxAgeHours.description: Maximum age of the most recent ARN observation.

tools.name: job_contract_compile
tools.description: Compile an AI agent job contract with objective acceptance criteria into ARN's deterministic canonical job-contract format. Supply a goal, deliverables and one or more supported machine-checkable criteria: bounded JSON Schema, exact JSON value, required or forbidden text, or SHA-256. Paid execution rejects ambiguous and unsupported fields, canonicalizes the contract and returns a SHA-256 contract hash. It does not claim work, execute it or move funds. Pair the result with execution_proof_pack after delivery. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

tools.name: execution_proof_pack
tools.description: Verify AI agent work delivery against acceptance criteria with ARN's independent artifact-verification service. Use the objective contract from job_contract_compile; paid execution recompiles it, hashes every supplied artifact, performs each supported JSON Schema, exact-value, required/forbidden-text or SHA-256 criterion, and returns APPROVED or QUARANTINED with per-check evidence and a tamper-evident pack hash. This verifies only the supplied contract and artifacts; it is not an AI-authorship detector, malware scan, factuality certificate or legal opinion. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

tools.name: delivery_assurance
tools.description: Run one paid end-to-end AI agent delivery assurance workflow as a neutral work-acceptance layer instead of letting the buyer or worker judge its own delivery. Supply privacy-preserving party references, objective work terms, named artifacts and all nine explicit release-gate outcomes. ARN compiles and hashes the contract, independently checks supported artifact criteria, screens bounded artifacts for exposed secret material, deterministically evaluates supplied gates, and—only after its verification fee settles—publishes an Ed25519-signed RELEASE_ELIGIBLE or HOLD_OR_DISPUTE receipt. Any agent can verify it offline with ARN's public JWKS. A free signed sandbox integration is available at /v1/integrations/delivery-assurance/sandbox and can never authorize settlement. ARN does not custody or transfer job funds. It does not perform a general malware scan, authenticate authorship, verify external facts, or certify caller-supplied legal or regulatory outcomes. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide.

tools.name: verified_translation
tools.description: Discover QA-verified translation for up to 2,000 characters on calibrated EN→ES, EN→FR, ES→FR and FR→ES routes. sourceLang defaults to EN, targetLang selects ES or FR, protectedTerms must remain unchanged, and optional context, domain or locale hints guide approved memory and wording; live locale research is excluded. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

tools.description: Discover deterministic duplicate removal for JSON-record arrays and structured research results. Supply one to eight identity fields: paid execution forms a typed composite key, preserves the first occurrence in original order, and reports exact input, output and duplicate counts; use dataset_profile when you only need duplicate measurement. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

tools.name: schema_infer
tools.description: Discover conservative JSON Schema inference from multiple flat JSON-object records for imports, API contract drafting or validation setup. Paid execution emits stable observed primitive/null type unions and marks a field required only when every row contains a non-null value; nested objects and arrays are rejected instead of guessed. Use dataset_profile for descriptive counts or json_schema_check to validate against an existing schema. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.

Use json_diff for arbitrary nested JSON or tabular_validate to enforce row contracts. This free MCP discovery call does not execute the advertised capability and does not charge; it returns the exact x402 endpoint, price and payment guide for execution.
